title: hedera helix var. roegneriana
intro: Hedera helix var. roegneriana, commonly known as Roegner's Ivy, is a variety of the common ivy plant (Hedera helix) native to Europe. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Roegner's Ivy include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic, making it useful for treating conditions such as anxiety, insomnia, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Hedera helix var. roegneriana include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
